risk: File-only cleanup. Caches rebuild or downloads recur; logs and diagnostics cannot be recovered. Close the owning application. Never removes directories, runs maintenance commands, or clears attributes/locks.

protectedRoots.windows: Windows servicing/service-owned filesystem target: administrator authority and service lifecycle are not implemented; no deletion offered.
protectedRoots.programData: Machine-wide shared cache/log target: administrator authority and cross-user ownership are not implemented; no deletion offered.
protectedRoots.programFiles: Installed-program tree: no administrator or installed-program deletion authority; no deletion offered.
protectedRoots.programFilesX86: Installed-program tree: no administrator or installed-program deletion authority; no deletion offered.
protectedRoots.systemDrive: Previous Windows installation rollback data: native servicing/rollback cleanup is not implemented; never remove recursively.

unsupportedOperations: Command execution is outside filesystem cleanup scope.
Pinned steam.json library hints and redistributable patterns are individually excluded in the Steam catalog: installed-program repair prerequisites are not disposable caches.
SQLite maintenance is not file cleanup; no database/sidecar deletion or command fallback.
